label: Login screen
description: The Bifrost login screen (greetd). It shows a copy of your look, wallpaper and picture, kept in /var/cache/bifrost-greeter.

settings.label: Your picture
settings.description: Shown above your name. Empty = ~/.face if it exists, otherwise your initials

settings.label: Keep the login screen in step
settings.description: Copies your theme, glass, wallpaper, picture, keyboard layout and displays to the login screen when they change (bifrostctl greeter sync)
